title: Prize titbit
html_source: A competition in the Titbits magazine for which a young Joyce wrote an article but didn’t enter. The article was referred to by Joyce as ‘Matcham’s Masterstroke’ in Ulysses as a joke. In it a Russian diplomat is murdered by a nihilist after a masked ball (Ellmann, p51).
